settings.claudeResets.autoRedeem.descrip: Spend eligible Claude Cedar or Juniper resets automatically. Cedar is spent only for covered limits; Juniper can only recover a sole 5-hour block. unset asks before the first spend, yes spends without prompting, and no disables blocked recovery and expiry salvage.
settings.claudeResets.autoRedeem.label: Claude Auto-Redeem Resets
settings.claudeResets.autoRedeem.options: Do not run Claude reset auto-redeem checks.
Check live eligibility, then ask before spending the first Claude reset.
Spend eligible Claude resets without prompting.
settings.claudeResets.keepCredits.descri: Keep at least this many Claude resets banked (0 allows the last eligible reset to be spent automatically). The reserve also applies to expiry salvage.
settings.claudeResets.keepCredits.label: Claude Auto-Redeem Reserve
Only auto-redeem when the natural unblock — the latest reset among the exhausted covered windows — is at least this many minutes away. A 5-hour-only reset is never used for a weekly or model-scoped block.
settings.claudeResets.salvageHorizonHour: Use a server-selected Cedar reset within this many hours of expiry only when its covered windows have meaningful usage to restore and the grant permits early use or a covered window is exhausted (0 disables salvage).
settings.codexResets.autoRedeem.descript: When a turn is blocked by the Codex weekly limit on the active account and no other account is available, run the conservative saved-reset check. unset asks before spending the first eligible reset, yes spends eligible resets without prompting, and no disables the check entirely. Requires retries enabled.
settings.codexResets.autoRedeem.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Saved Resets
Do not run the saved-reset auto-redeem check.
Check eligibility, then ask before spending the first saved reset.
Spend eligible saved resets without prompting.
settings.codexResets.keepCredits.descrip: Never auto-spend below this many saved resets (0 = the last credit may be spent automatically).
settings.codexResets.keepCredits.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Reserve
settings.codexResets.minBlockedMinutes.d: Only auto-redeem when the natural weekly reset is at least this many minutes away (don't spend a ~30-day credit to save a short wait).
settings.codexResets.salvageHorizonHours: Spend a saved Codex reset automatically when it would otherwise expire within this many hours and either chat window (5h or weekly) has meaningful usage to restore (0 disables expiry salvage).
